devdoc.details: Uses OpenZeppelin AccessControl for role-based permissions.

AccessControlBadConfirmation().details: The caller of a function is not the expected one. NOTE: Don't confuse with {AccessControlUnauthorizedAccount}.

params.users: An array of addresses added to the blacklist.
An array of addresses removed from the blacklist.

RoleAdminChanged(bytes32,bytes32,bytes32.details: Emitted when `newAdminRole` is set as ``role``'s admin role, replacing `previousAdminRole` `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE` is the starting admin for all roles, despite {RoleAdminChanged} not being emitted to signal this.

RoleGranted(bytes32,address,address).details: Emitted when `account` is granted `role`. `sender` is the account that originated the contract call. This account bears the admin role (for the granted role). Expected in cases where the role was granted using the internal {AccessControl-_grantRole}.

RoleRevoked(bytes32,address,address).details: Emitted when `account` is revoked `role`. `sender` is the account that originated the contract call:   - if using `revokeRole`, it is the admin role bearer   - if using `renounceRole`, it is the role bearer (i.e. `account`)

params.users: An array of addresses added to the whitelist.
An array of addresses removed from the whitelist.

params.enabled: The new whitelist state - true if enabled, false if disabled.

addBlacklist(address[]).details: Only callable by accounts with OPERATOR_ROLE.

params._users: Array of addresses to be blacklisted.

addWhitelist(address[]).details: Only callable by accounts with OPERATOR_ROLE.

params._users: Array of addresses to be whitelisted.

getRoleAdmin(bytes32).details: Returns the admin role that controls `role`. See {grantRole} and {revokeRole}. To change a role's admin, use {_setRoleAdmin}.

grantRole(bytes32,address).details: Grants `role` to `account`. If `account` had not been already granted `role`, emits a {RoleGranted} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleGranted} event.

returns._0: True if the address is blacklisted, false otherwise
True if the address is whitelisted, false otherwise

removeBlacklist(address[]).details: Only callable by accounts with OPERATOR_ROLE.

params._users: Array of addresses to be removed from blacklist.

removeWhitelist(address[]).details: Only callable by accounts with OPERATOR_ROLE.

params._users: Array of addresses to be removed from whitelist.

renounceRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from the calling account. Roles are often managed via {grantRole} and {revokeRole}: this function's purpose is to provide a mechanism for accounts to lose their privileges if they are compromised (such as when a trusted device is misplaced). If the calling account had been revoked `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must be `callerConfirmation`. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

revokeRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from `account`. If `account` had been granted `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

setWhitelistEnabled(bool).details: Only callable by accounts with the ADMIN_ROLE.

params._enabled: Boolean flag - true to enable the whitelist, false to disable it.

supportsInterface(bytes4).details: Returns true if this contract implements the interface defined by `interfaceId`. See the corresponding https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-165#how-interfaces-are-identified[ERC section] to learn more about how these ids are created. This function call must use less than 30 000 gas.

_blacklist.details: Address => true if blacklisted, false otherwise.

_whitelist.details: Address => true if whitelisted, false otherwise.

isWhitelistEnabled.details: True if whitelist mode is enabled, false otherwise.

InvalidArrayLength().notice: Thrown when array lengths do not match or are zero.

ZeroAddress().notice: Thrown when a provided address is zero.

BlacklistRemoved(address[]).notice: Emitted when an array of users is removed from the blacklist.

WhitelistAdded(address[]).notice: Emitted when an array of users is added to the whitelist.

WhitelistRemoved(address[]).notice: Emitted when an array of users is removed from the whitelist.

addBlacklist(address[]).notice: Add multiple users to the blacklist.

addWhitelist(address[]).notice: Add multiple users to the whitelist.

constructor.notice: Deploys the contract and assigns initial admin and operator roles.

isBlacklisted(address).notice: Checks whether a given address is blacklisted

isWhitelistEnabled().notice: Whether the whitelist mode is enabled.

isWhitelisted(address).notice: Checks whether a given address is whitelisted

removeWhitelist(address[]).notice: Remove multiple users from the whitelist.

setWhitelistEnabled(bool).notice: Enables or disables the whitelist feature.
